(1) the genes encoding the heat shock proteins (hsp70, hsp 90, hsp 105) and the sodium calcium exchanger are upregulated following global cerebral ischemic injury in rats and (2) the trkB gene, which encodes the high affinity nerve growth factor receptor, is also upregulated.
(1) ischemia upregulates the expression of heat shock proteins and trkB, and (2) ischemia upregulated ncx, which is known to be up regulated in the heart during ischemia.

(1) ischemic preconditioning is associated with upregulation of genes that encode proteins known to be up-regulated following global cerebral ischemic insult, and (2) ischemic preconditionig is associated with up-regulation of a gene that encodes sodium calcium exchanger, a novel gene that has not previously been implicated with cerebral ischemic injury.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of genes upregulated following ischemic preconditioning in the rat hippocampus.
the identification of ischemia-induced genes and their potential role in preconditioning.
the development of a subtracted hippocampal cDNA library that can be used to identify genes upregulated following global cerebral ischemic injury.

the upregulation of hsp70, hsp70, and trkB genes following cerebral ischemia has been demonstrated in the rat hippocampus, and the upregulation was confirmed by northern analysis.
